The output value of the red gamma table for an input value, as set by [SetGamma](SetGamma). By default every value gives itself.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetGamma 100, 100, 100, 200, 200, 200
UpdateGamma
Print GammaRed(100) + " " + GammaGreen(100) + " " + GammaBlue(100)
Print GammaRed(101)
WaitKey
```
@param red  The input value, 0 to 255.
@returns The output value for the input.
@gap The gamma tables are only remembered. They never change how the display looks.
